en: Philosophy is the science of the absolute ground of things, and indeed of them not in their individuality or particularity, but in their universality.
zh: 哲学是关于事物的绝对根据的科学，而且这个根据不是就事物的个别性或特殊性，而是就其普遍性而言。

en: Thinking contemplates the universal of things.
Logic is the science of thinking.
zh: 思维观照事物的普遍者。
逻辑学是思维的科学。

en: Feeling is the way in which, and in so far as, we are affected by an object.
zh: 感受是我们受一个对象感发的方式，以及在这种意义上我们受其感发的方式。

en: Pleasure, displeasure, beauty.
Admiration, love, fear, hatred, aversion are inner feelings; what we are in the presence of such objects; in this respect we do not speak of the object as ... subjectively; in which we are in it.
zh: 愉悦、不悦、美。
惊异、爱、恐惧、憎恶、厌恶是内在的感受；我们面对这类对象时是些什么；在这个意义上我们并不主观地谈论对象……；我们在其中所是的东西。

en: In representing we separate ourselves from the object and ascribe to it determinations that it has, without looking to whether we are affected by them or not.41)
zh: 在表象中，我们与对象分离开来，并把对象所具有的规定归给它，而不去看我们是否受这些规定感发。41)

en: A sensuous object is immediately perceived by us and is an individual of manifold sensuous determinations or properties which belong to feeling and become something objective in representation.
zh: 一个感性对象直接被我们知觉到，它是由多种多样的感性规定或属性所成的个别者，这些规定属于感受，并在表象中成为某种对象性的东西。

en: Such a determination, taken out by itself and separated from the others with which it was connected in the object, is an abstract sensuous representation.
zh: 这样一个规定，被单独提取出来，并从它在对象中原本与之相连的其余规定中分离出来，就是一个抽象的感性表象。

en: Such a determination belongs not only to some single object but to several, or is common to them, thus it is a universal sensuous representation.
zh: 这样一个规定不仅归属于某一个别的对象，而是归属于多个对象，或为它们所共有，因此它就是一个普遍的感性表象。

en: At the same time it is no longer entirely immediate, as it was in feeling, but at the same time it is something mediated; for it arose through the separation from the other determinations and from the individual object.
zh: 它同时不再完全是直接的，如它在感受中所是的那样，而同时是一个被中介者；因为它是通过从其他规定以及从个别对象中分离出来而产生的。

en: It has one side which belongs to feeling, namely sensuous individuality.
But they also have a side which constitutes sensuous universality and is the form of sensuousness.
This form is the double one, space and time.
zh: 它有一个属于感受的方面，即感性的个别性。
但它们也有一个方面，这个方面构成感性的普遍性，是感性的形式。
这一形式是双重的，即空间与时间。

en: Both are inseparable continua, in which the differences and limitations that are posited in them constitute no true limit, but only a quantitative limit.
zh: 两者是不可分离的连续体，其中所设置的差别与限制并不构成真正的界限，而只构成量的界限。

en: Space is the relation of the quiescent being-outside-and-beside-one-another of things; time is the relation of their disappearance or their alteration.
zh: 空间是诸物静止的彼此在外、并列的关系，时间是诸物消失或变化的关系。

en: Space is the qualitative limit of time, and time the limit of space.
In empty space no movement, for movement [is only] in the comparison of a different place.
A difference of place, hence no space - When I think of the I, of virtue, - of time, I do not represent any space to myself.
zh: 空间是时间的质的界限，而时间是空间的界限。
在空无一人的空间里没有运动，因为运动[只]在于对一个不同地方的比较。
一种位置的差别，因而就没有空间——当我想到我、美德、——时间时，我并不为自己表象出任何空间。

en: The object further contains determinations which belong to the understanding and are universal, unsensible forms, and are called categories.
zh: 对象还包含一些规定，它们属于知性，是普遍的、无感性的形式，叫做范畴。

en: Above the category there stands still the concept, which is not only a universal determination of thought, but expresses the determinate nature of an object and is treated together with judgments and syllogisms in the ordinarily so-called logic.
It falls apart into the doctrine of concepts, of judgments, and of syllogisms.
zh: 在范畴之上还矗立着概念，概念不仅是一般的思维规定，而且表达一个对象的规定了的本性，并且在通常所谓的逻辑学中是与判断和推论一起得到处理的。
它分为关于概念、判断和推论的学说。

en: The concept does not contain the manifold and sensible determinations of an object, but the object itself 1. according to its universal essence, 2. according to its essential particularity; 3. the determinate being of the concept constitutes the moment of individuality.
zh: 概念不包含一个对象杂多的、感性的规定，而是包含该对象本身：1. 按照它的一般本质，2. 按照它的本质性的特殊性；3. 概念的定在构成个别性的环节。

en: The universal essence and the particularity of an object, by which it distinguishes itself from others and which is a restriction of the universal, belong to the concept-marks of an object.
zh: 一个对象的一般本质与特殊性——对象借此与别的对象相区别，而它又是普遍者的一种限制——属于一个对象的概念标志。

en: The universal is restricted in the particularity, without thereby however suffering a change; likewise the particular by the individual.
Conversely, on the other hand, the individual, which is extended into the particular, as well as the particular, which is extended into the universal, thereby lose of their content.
zh: 普遍者在特殊性中受到限制，但它并不因此遭受变化，特殊者受个别者的限制也是一样。
反过来则相反，个别者被扩展为特殊者，以及特殊者被扩展为普遍者，都因此失掉了自己的内容。

en: The universal comprehends the particular and the individual, as the particular has the individual under itself.
The particular and the individual are subsumed under the universal, as the individual is subsumed under the particular.
What holds of the universal holds also of the particular and the individual; and what holds of the particular, also of the individual.
But not conversely.
zh: 普遍者包含特殊者和个别者，正如特殊者把个别者包含在自己之下。
特殊者和个别者被归摄在普遍者之下，正如个别者被归摄在特殊者之下。
对普遍者成立的，对特殊者和个别者也成立；对特殊者成立的，对个别者也成立。
但不是反过来。

en: The individual, on the other hand, comprehends in itself the particularity and the universality, and the particular comprehends the universality in itself, or the particularity and universality inhere in the individual; as also the universality in the particular.
zh: 个别者则反过来把特殊性与普遍性包含在自己之中，特殊者则把普遍性包含在自己之中，或者说，特殊性、普遍性固有个别者；普遍性同样固有特殊者。

en: The universal is wider than [the] particular and the individual, and the particular is wider than the individual or has a more extensive sphere; on the contrary, the particular and the individual contain more properties in themselves than the universal, and the individual more than the particular.

The individual or concrete is richer in the multiplicity of the determinacies than the particular and the universal; on the contrary, the universal contains more under itself than the particular and the individual, and the particular more than the individual.
zh: 普遍者比[那个]特殊者和个别者更广，特殊者也比个别者更广，或者说有一个更广的领域；反过来，特殊者和个别者比普遍者包含更多属性，个别者又比特殊者包含更多。
个别者或具体者在规定性的多样性上比特殊者和普遍者更丰富；反过来，普遍者比特殊者和个别者包含更多，特殊者又比个别者包含更多。

en: The particular determinations of one and the same universal as well as the manifold determinacies of the individual are coordinated with one another.

The coordinated determinations of the universal are contradictorily opposed to one another insofar as [one] is taken only as the negative of the other; insofar as the other is, however, something positive in addition, they are contrarily opposed to one another.
zh: 同一个普遍者的特殊规定以及个别者的种种规定性是彼此并列的。
普遍者中这些并列的规定彼此矛盾地对立着，因为只要[其中一个]只被当作另一个的否定的东西；但就另一个此外还是某种肯定的东西而言，它们彼此反对地对立着。

en: Under a contradictory determination one does not understand merely the lack of any determinacy.
Of the contradictory determinations, furthermore, each one requires the other for its concept.
zh: 在矛盾的规定之下，并不只理解为匮乏某种规定性。
在矛盾的规定中，每一项就其概念而言还要求另一项。

en: The contrary determinations, by contrast, are indifferent to one another, and each appears as one to which the other is not necessary and which would obtain even if the other were not.
zh: 相反的规定却彼此无关，并且每一项都表现为这样一种规定：另一项对它并非必然，而且即使没有另一项，它也会成立。

en: More closely, the universal determinations which concern the content of the concept and are considered in the form of laws: a) the essential determination of an object in general is the equality with itself or its identity.
zh: 再细看那些涉及概念的内容、并且是以规律的形式来考察的普遍规定：a) 一个对象总体的本质规定就是与自身的等同，或者说它的同一性。

en: This determination expressed as a law is called the law of identity or of contradiction: Every thing is equal to itself, or A cannot be non-A at the same time.
zh: 这一规定表述为规律，就叫做同一性规律或矛盾规律：每个东西都与自身等同，或者说 A 不能同时是非-A。

en: b) Difference is the distinction insofar as what is distinguished does not relate itself to something other through itself; the difference with respect to something other thus falls into a third term of comparison, which expresses the equality or inequality of things.
zh: b) 相异就是差别，就被区别者本身并不通过自身与一个他物相关而言；而与一个他物的相异因此落入第三个比较者，它说出诸物的等同或不等同。

en: Difference as such in general is merely multiplicity, so that of the many each is only one thing in general, hence the same as the others, and thus properly speaking no distinction is posited.
zh: 相异本身一般说来就是单纯的众多，以致在众多者中每一个一般说来只是一个东西，因而就是与其他者相同的东西；这样其实就并没有设定差别。

en: Difference is therefore first present in the determinacies, and through these things are distinguished from one another.

The law which is derived from this is accordingly as follows: there are not 2 things which are completely equal to one another, i.e. which would not be distinguished from one another through some property, circumstance, or other determination.
zh: 因此相异首先存在于规定性之中，诸物正是通过这些规定性而彼此有差别。
由此得出的规律因此是：不存在两个彼此完全等同的东西，也就是说，不存在没有通过某种属性、情况或其他规定而彼此有差别的两个东西。

en: c) In the opposition difference is such that one thing is only insofar as it is not the other, and at the same time is not insofar as the other is, or that in its concept this, its opposed, lies immediately.
zh: c) 在对立中，相异是这样的：一个东西只有在它不是他物时才存在，而同时又不是在他物存在的限度内存在，或者说，在它的概念中直接就含着这个作为它对立面的东西。

en: The opposition expressed as a law: Of opposed determinations only one accrues to a thing: A is either B or not B, and there is no third.
zh: 把对立表述为规律：对立的规定中只有一项归于一个东西：A 要么是 B，要么不是 B，并且没有第三个。

en: d) The unity of the opposed, or the ground.
The opposed, insofar as they are in a relation without which they would not be, have a common essential unity.

A determinate being, insofar as it contains another in itself at the same time, is the ground of this other determinate being; since now every determinate being is something determinate, it is related to another and is in itself contained in this other; hence the law follows: what is, since it is essentially determinate and opposed, has its sufficient ground.
zh: d) 对立者的统一，或根据。
对立者，由于它们处在一种没有这种关系它们就不存在的关系里，具有一个共同的本质统一。
一个定在，就它在自在地同时包含着另一个而言，是这另一个定在的根据；既然每一个定在都是某种规定的东西，它便是关联于另一个，并且自在地包含在这另一个之中；因此规律随之而来：凡是存在的东西，由于它是一个本质上被规定并且是对立的东西，就有它足够的根据。

en: The determinacies indicated have a necessary order in relation to one another, and in the comparison of several determinacies which at first seem to behave only contrarily, i.e. indifferently without an inner relation, one must try whether they do not have a necessary order in relation to one another.
zh: 所给出的规定性彼此具有必然的秩序，而在比较若干规定性——它们起初似乎只是相互抵触，即无内在关系而显得无所谓——时，须试着看它们是否也彼此具有必然的秩序。

en: The description contains the manifold both accidental and essential properties and determinacies of an object, and expresses not so much the concept of it as the image for the representation.
zh: 描述包含一个对象的多样的、既偶然又本质的属性与规定，并且所表达的不是它的概念，而是供表象之用的意象。

en: Poetic description of the rising of the sun; God's — animal, flower
zh: 对日出的诗艺描写；上帝——动物、花朵

en: The definition, on the contrary, expresses the concept-marks of an object indicated above; its universal nature and then the particularity of the same object, by which it distinguishes itself from others which have the same universal nature.
zh: 定义则相反，表达一个对象上面所说的那些概念标志：它的普遍本性，以及继而是它的特殊性——它凭着这种特殊性把自己区别于那些具有同一普遍本性的其他者。

en: Figure triangle rose — red and flower also univ. nearest universal nature, genus, not particular
Species; of individual things only descriptions
zh: 形状 三角形 玫瑰——红，花 也普遍 最近的普遍本性，属，不是特殊
种；对个别的东西只有描述

en: Division or partition starts out from a universal and expresses how a determinacy of it (the principle of partition) presents itself in its differences, which differences are either merely accidental or else behave toward one another according to the necessary distinctions indicated above.
zh: 细分或划分从一个普遍者出发，表达它的某个规定（划分的根据）如何在它的种种相异中呈现出来，这些相异或者只是偶然的，或者按照上面指出的必然差别彼此相对。

en: The judgment is the relation of two concept-determinations to one another, of which the one relates itself as the individual to the other as the particular or as the universal, or as the particular to the universal.
zh: 判断是两个概念规定彼此的关系，其中一个作为个别与另一个作为特殊或作为普遍相关，或者作为特殊与作为普遍相关。

en: Of the narrower and the broader determination which are related to one another, the former is the subject, the latter however the predicate; the relation of the two, the 'is', [is] the copula.
zh: 在彼此关联着的较窄规定与较宽规定之中，前者是主体，后者则是谓词；两者的关系，那个「是」，[就是]连系词。

en: Logic abstracts from all empirical content and considers only that content which is posited by the form of the relation itself; accordingly the logical judgment properly means: an individual is a particular or a universal, or the particular is a universal.
zh: 逻辑学从一切经验内容中抽象出来，只考察那种由关系自身的形式所设定的内容；因此逻辑的判断确切地说：一个个别是一个特殊或一个普遍，或者特殊是一个普遍。

en: Not every proposition is a judgment, but only such a one as — or insofar as — its content has that relation to one another.
zh: 并非每个命题都是判断，而只有其内容具有那种彼此关系的命题——或者就其内容具有那种彼此关系而言——才是判断。

en: Further, since in the judgment the concept-determinations fall apart and behave toward one another as different in their relation, only such a proposition is a judgment in which the predicate is presented for itself and is united by comparison with the subject.
zh: 此外，由于在判断中概念规定彼此分离开来并在它们的关系中互为相异，所以只有这样的命题才是判断：其中谓词被单独表象出来，并通过与主体的比较而结合起来。

en: I see a man, a color in the distance. Magnetic force manifests itself in two poles; proposition of experience.
There my good friend passed by. The universal free in and for itself, indifferent toward the individual (this thing is red; here is something red).
zh: 我看见一个人，远处的颜色。磁力表现在两个极上；经验命题。
那儿我的好朋友走过去了。普遍者自在自为地自由，对个别性漠不相干（这个事物是红的；这里有某种红色的东西）。

en: Considered more closely, the predicate of the judgment is α) a determination at all against the subject or other determinations and has in this respect a content; β) it is unequal to the subject, as the universal against the individual; γ) as related to the subject it is restricted to the same and can be regarded as being only of the range within which the subject is.
zh: 把判断的谓词细看之下，它是 α) 对主体或对其他规定来说的一个一般规定，并且就这一面有一个内容；β) 它与主体不等同，作为普遍者与个别者相对；γ) 就与主体相关而言，它被限制在这个主体上，可以看作只就主体所处的那个范围而言。

en: The subject is likewise α) different from other subjects, β) it is likewise different from the predicate as one subsumed under it, γ) it is equal to the predicate, which expresses its content, so that in the judgment nothing is really expressed of the subject except what the predicate contains.
zh: 主体同样 α) 与其他主体相异，β) 它同样与谓词相异，是被归摄在谓词之下的东西，γ) 它与谓词等同，谓词表达着它的内容，以致判断中关于主体实际上所表达出来的，无非是谓词所包含的东西。

90.en: [I.] Judgments of inherence or of quality
90.zh: [I.] 依存的判断或质的判断

en: The predicate in the judgment is first of all a quality, some simple immediate determinacy or property which inheres in the subject and of which the subject contains several in itself.
zh: 判断中的谓词首先是一种质，某种简单的直接的规定性或属性，它依存于主体，而主体自身包含着它的好几个。

en: Since in the qualitative judgment the predicate is affirmed of the subject, it is an affirmative judgment.
zh: 由于在质的判断中谓词就主体而言被肯定，它就是一个肯定判断。

en: The predicate has a wider range than the subject; if therefore the affirmative judgment were simply reversed, i. e. the predicate were made into the subject and the subject into the predicate, then the predicate would henceforth be narrower than the subject, which is against the concept of the judgment.
zh: 谓词的范围比主体更宽；因此，如果把肯定判断径直反过来，即把谓词变成主体、把主体变成谓词，那么此时这个谓词就会比主体更窄，这违背判断的概念。

en: An affirmative judgment can therefore be reversed only insofar as the predicate is taken and expressed under its restriction to the subject.
zh: 所以肯定判断只有在谓词就它对主体的限制被取用并被表述出来时，才可以反过来。

en: A negative judgment is one in which a predicate is negated of a subject altogether.
zh: 否定判断是这样的判断：其中谓词就主体而言总括地被否定。

en: Considered more closely, the predicate has on it the two moments of determinacy toward others and then of the universal sphere; in the negative judgment only the predicate as determinacy is negated, not the universal sphere of the same.
zh: 谓词细看之下身上带有两个环节：对他物的规定性，以及随后的一般领域；在否定判断中，只是作为规定性的谓词被否定，它的一般领域则不被否定。

en: Or in the negative judgment the subject is related negatively to the predicate; thus along with the negation there is at the same time a positing of the predicate, and indeed of it as universal sphere.
zh: 或者说，在否定判断中主体与谓词是否定地相关的；因此，与否定同时也就有了谓词的确立，而且正是把它作为一般领域的确立。

en: A negative judgment can simply be reversed.
zh: 否定判断可以直接反过来。

en: An infinite judgment is one in which not only the determinacy of the predicate but also the universal sphere is negated.
zh: 无限判断是这样的判断：其中不仅谓词的规定性被否定，一般领域也被否定。

en: The infinite judgment contains within itself the further sense that whatever is a subject is not exhausted in a predicate which expresses a quality of it, neither insofar as this quality expresses a nearest determinacy, still less insofar as it contains a further determinacy, which of the general sphere,
zh: 无限判断自身包含着进一步的意义：凡是一个主体存在的东西，都没有在一个谓词里被穷尽，而这个谓词表达出它的一个质——既不在这个质表达一项最近的规定性这一点上，更不在它含有一项属于一般领域的进一步的规定性这一点上。

111.en: II. Judgments of Quantity or of Reflection
111.zh: II. 量的判断或反思判断

en: Reflecting means going beyond something immediate and on to something else, and comprehending the manifoldness that thereby arises into a unity.
zh: 反思就是：越过某个直接者而继续走向别的东西，并把由此产生的杂多综合为一个统一。

en: A determinacy of reflection thus contains partly a comparison of [an object] with others and the aspect with respect to which, in its qualities, it is the same as that same one or differs from it, partly a comprehension of its own determinations, which however expresses only an external universality and commonality, or even mere completeness.
zh: 所以，一项反思的规定，一部分包含[一个对象]与他者的比较，以及它凭其诸质与同一个等同、或与同一个相别的那个方面，另一部分包含对自身诸规定的综合；这种综合却只表达一种外在的普遍性和共同性，或者干脆只是完整性。

en: The individual judgment expresses of a subject such a predicate as belongs only to it and by which it distinguishes itself from all others; the subject is accordingly likewise an individual.
zh: 个别判断从一个主体表达出这样一个谓词：这个谓词只属于该主体，并使它把自己与所有其他者区别开来；主体因此同样是一个个别者。

en: Classification of natural beings according to differences in number, an external mark of distinction.
zh: 自然存在物按数目差别所作的分类，外在的区别标志。

en: An individual judgment can in a broader sense also be called such when its subject is an individual, even though a universal predicate is said of it, which however serves at least to distinguish it from the others that come into consideration.
zh: 在更宽的意义上，当一个判断的主体是一个个别者时，它也可以被称作个别判断，虽然关于它被说出了一个普遍的谓词，但这个谓词至少足以把它与那些纳入考虑的其他者区别开来。

en: A particular judgment has some individuals for its subject.
zh: 特称判断以若干个别者为主语。

en: In the universal judgment the subject is a comprehension of all the individuals of one kind; this comprehension is the allness, or the universality of reflection, [and] the predicate which belongs to such a subject is likewise the universal of these individuals, namely as what is common to them.
zh: 在全称判断中，主体是一个种的全体个别者的综合；这一综合就是全体性，或者说反思的普遍性，[而]属于这样一个主体的谓词同样也是这些个别者的普遍者，即作为它们之中的共同者。

124.en: III. Judgments of Relation or of Necessity
124.zh: III. 关系的判断或必然性的判断

en: Subject and predicate [here] necessarily belong together through their content.
zh: [在这里]主体与谓词由于其内容而必然地属于一起。

en: Categorical judgment.
The predicate expresses the nature or the truly universal of the subject, and the two have the same essential content (and the subject is only a particularity of the predicate).
The further determinations which the subject has over and above what such a predicate contains are inessential properties or merely its restrictions.
zh: 定言判断。
谓词表达主体的本性，或者表达主体真正普遍的东西，而两者具有同一个本质的内容（并且主体只是谓词的一个特殊性）。
主体除了这样一个谓词所含内容之外所还具有的进一步规定，是不本质的属性，或者仅仅是它的限制。

en: In the hypothetical judgment the necessity does not lie in the equality of the content, but this content is rather different, and what is said in this judgment is only this: that two determinations stand in a necessary connection as ground and consequence.
zh: 在假言判断中，必然性并不在于内容的等同，毋宁说内容是互不相同的；而在这一判断中所说出的只是这一点：两项规定作为根据与后果，处于一种必然的联系之中。

en: In the disjunctive judgment the subject is considered as a general sphere, which in this respect can have different determinations, but, because these exclude one another, must necessarily have only one of them with the exclusion of the rest.
zh: 在选言判断中，主体被看作一个一般领域，它可以就此具有不同的规定；但因为这些规定相互排斥，所以它必然只能具有其中之一，并排除其余的。

en: Judgments according to their modality [to consider means to examine whether the] predicate [expresses the] adequacy of the concept and of the determinate being of the subject.
zh: 按其模态来考察判断，[就是考察]谓词[是否]表达概念与[主体的]定在的相宜。

en: Assertive [judgments].
The constitution of the subject not yet developed.
zh: 断言的[判断]。
主体的性质尚未展开。

en: Against the mere undeveloped44) assertion of the assertive judgment, the opposite assertion can be maintained with the same formal right.
Insofar as thereby there is only the possibility that either the one or the opposite predicate accrues to the subject, the judgment is problematic.
zh: 对断言式判断仅仅尚未展开的44)断言，可以用同样的形式权利主张相反的断言。
只要由此仅仅存在一种可能性，即主体将会得到那一个谓词或与之相反的谓词，那么这个判断就是有问题的。

en: The subject45) is therefore to be posited with a determination which expresses its constitution, in which the appropriateness or inappropriateness of determinate being with the concept lies.
This modal judgment is apodictic.
zh: 因此主体45)须用一个表达其性质的规定来设定，而在这一规定中，落定的是定在与概念相宜还是不相宜。
这个模态判断是断言式的。

en: In the judgment two moments of the concept are immediately related to one another; the syllogism contains their mediation or their ground; in it two determinations are joined together by a third, which is their unity.
zh: 在判断中，概念的两个环节被直接地互相关联；推论包含它们的中介或它们的根据；其中两个规定由第三个——即它们的统一——结合在一起。

en: The two determinations joined together are the extremes, termini extremi; the determination connecting them is their middle, terminus medius.
zh: 那两个结合在一起的规定是极端，termini extremi；把它们连接起来的规定是它们的中项，terminus medius。

en: The two extremes behave toward one another like individuality and universality, the middle as particularity.
zh: 两个极端彼此相关如同个别性与普遍性，中项则是特殊性。

en: The middle behaves as subsuming toward individuality, as subsumed toward universality.
zh: 中项对个别性表现为归摄的一方，对普遍性表现为被归摄的一方。

en: Since the universal subsumes the particular under itself, and the particular subsumes the individual under itself, so the universal also subsumes the individual under itself, and the former is predicate of the latter.

Or conversely, since the individual contains in itself the determination of the particular, but the particular the determinacy of the universal, so the individual also contains the universal in itself.
zh: 既然普遍性归摄特殊性于自身之下，而特殊性又归摄个别者于自身之下，那么普遍性也归摄个别者于自身之下，并且前者是后者的谓词。
或者反过来，个别者在自身中包含特殊的规定，而特殊性包含普遍的规定性，于是个别者也在自身中包含普遍性。

en: The relations of the two extremes to the middle are immediate; these relations expressed as propositions or judgments are called the premises of the syllogism, namely the one which contains the extreme of universality (terminus maior), the propositio maior, the one which contains the extreme of individuality, the [propositio] minor.
zh: 两个极端对中项的关系是直接的；这些关系表达为命题或判断时，就叫做推论的前提，即那个包含普遍性这一极端（terminus maior）的，那叫 propositio maior；那个包含个别性这一极端的，那叫 [propositio] minor。

en: The relation of the two extremes to one another is the mediated one and is called the syllogistic conclusion, conclusio.
zh: 两个极端彼此之间的这个关系就是被中介了的关系，叫做推论句，conclusio。

en: The minor premise cannot be negative.
zh: 小前提不能是否定的。

en: Proposition: nothing particular[es].
zh: 命题：无特称[es]之物。

en: The Medius terminus in the major premise is not particular.
zh: 大前提中的 Medius terminus（中项）不是特称的。

161.en: 6. Doctrine of Concepts for the Upper Class47)

en: Objective logic is the science of the concept in itself, or of the categories.
Subjective logic, which is dealt with here, is the science of the concept as concept or of the concept of something.
It divides itself into three parts:
zh: 客观逻辑是关于自在的概念或诸范畴的科学。
主观逻辑——这里所要论述的——是作为概念的概念或关于某物的概念的科学。
它分为三个部分：

en: 1. into the doctrine of the concept,
zh: 1. 关于概念的理论，

en: 2. into the doctrine of its realization,
zh: 2. 关于其实现的理论，

en: 3. into the doctrine of the idea.
zh: 3. 关于观念的理论。

en: The concept is the universal which is at the same time determinate, which [however] in its determination remains the same whole, the universal, or the determinacy which comprises the various determinations of a thing in itself as a unity.
zh: 概念是那个同时被规定的普遍者，它[但]在自己的规定中仍然是同一个整体、同一个普遍者，或者说是那种把一事物的各种规定作为一个整体包含于自身之内的规定性。

en: The moments of the concept are universality, particularity, and individuality.
It is their unity.
zh: 概念的环节是普遍性、特殊性和个别性。
它就是它们的统一。

en: The universal is this unity as a positive, self-identical indeterminate unity; – particularity is the determination of the universal, but in such a way that it is sublated in the universal or the universal remains in it what it is; – individuality is the negative unity or the determination which gathers itself together into self-determination.
zh: 普遍者是这种作为肯定的、自身同一的、无规定的统一；——特殊性是普遍者的规定，但以这样的方式，即它在普遍者中被扬弃，或者普遍者在它之中保持其所是；——个别性是否定的统一，或者说是把自身概括为自我规定的规定。

en: The universal comprises under itself the particular and the individual, and the particular also the individual; by contrast, the individual comprises in itself particularity and universality, and the particular universality.

The universal is wider than particularity and individuality; by contrast, particularity and individuality comprise more in themselves than the universal, which thereby, because it is comprised in individuality, again becomes a determinacy.
The universal inheres in the particular and the individual, whereas it subsumes the particular and the individual under itself.
zh: 普遍者把特殊者和个别者、以及特殊者把个别者也包含于自身之下；反之，个别者把特殊性和普遍性、特殊者把普遍性包含于自身之内。
普遍者比特殊性和个别性更广；反之，特殊性和个别性在自身中包含的比普遍者更多，普遍者由于被包含在个别性之中，因而又重新成为一种规定性。
普遍者固有于特殊者和个别者之中，反之它把特殊者和个别者归摄于自身之下。

en: Just as the concept contains in itself the moments of individuality, particularity, and universality, so it is itself accordingly differently determined in its content and is the concept of something individual, particular, or universal.
zh: 正如概念在自身中包含个别性、特殊性和普遍性的环节，它自己也据此在其内容上被不同地规定，并且是关于某个个别者、特殊者或普遍者的概念。

en: The particularization of the universal, i.e. determinations which have one and the same universal sphere, as well as the individuals which are subsumed under the same particularity or universality, are coordinated with one another, just as the subsumed is subordinated to that by which it is subsumed.
zh: 普遍者的特殊化，即拥有同一个一般领域的种种规定，以及被归摄在同一特殊性或普遍性之下的个别者，彼此并列，正如被归摄者隶属于归摄它的那个东西。

en: The coordinated particular determinations of the universal are opposed to one another, and insofar as the one is taken only as the negative of the other, they are contradictory; insofar as the other, however, also has a positivity, through which it at the same time falls under the same universal sphere, they are only contrarily opposed.

Such determinations coordinated in the universal cannot be in the individual at the same time; rather, those coordinated in the latter are different, i.e. they do not have in their difference the same universal sphere, and they are concordant in relation to the individual.
zh: 普遍者的这些并列的特殊规定彼此对立；只要其中一个只被当作另一个的否定的东西，它们就是矛盾的；但另一个也还有一种肯定性，凭这种肯定性它同时落入同一个一般领域，就此而言它们只是反对地对立。
这种在普遍者中并列的规定不能同时存在于个别者之中；相反，在个别者中并列的那些规定是不同的，即它们在彼此的区别中没有同一个一般领域，而就个别者而言彼此一致。

en: The coordinated determinations of the universal, considered more closely, are 1. the one the negative of the other at all, undetermined whether they have the same universal sphere or not; 2. insofar as they share the same sphere in common and one determination is positive, the other negative, so that this negativity against the first constitutes their nature, they are properly contradictorily opposed; 3. insofar as they are opposed in the same universal sphere, or the one is positive in the same way as the other, each thus can equally well be pronounced positive or negative in relation to the other, they are contrary.
zh: 把普遍者的这些并列规定细看之下，它们是 1. 一个总括地是另一个的否定的东西，不确定它们是否具有同一个一般领域；2. 只要它们共同拥有同一个领域，并且一个规定是肯定的、另一个是否定的，以致这种对第一个的否定性构成后者的本性，它们就真正是矛盾地对立的；3. 只要它们在同一个一般领域中对立，或者说一个与另一个以同样的方式也是肯定的，因而每一项就与另一项的关系而言都同样可以被称为肯定的或否定的，它们就是相反的。

en: With the contrary determination, which is indifferent to the opposition of the positive and the negative, the transition occurs into not-being-determined through an other, into being-determined in and for itself, whereby the commonness of the sphere becomes different48) and individuality is [posited], whose determinations are different without a universal sphere and in which they are as ones determined in and for themselves.
zh: 随着那种反对的规定——它对肯定与否定的对立漠不相干——就发生了过渡：过渡到通过一个他物而未被规定，过渡到自在自为地被规定；由此领域的共同性成为不同的48)，个别性[被确立]了，个别性的种种规定各不相同而没有一般领域，并且在个别性中它们是作为自在自为地被规定的东西而存在的。

en: The judgment is the presentation of an object in the distinct moments of the concept.

It contains the same a) in the determination of individuality, as subject; b) its determination of universality or its predicate — whereby, however, the subject can also relate to the predicate as individuality relates to particularity and as particularity relates to universality; c) the simple, contentless relation of the predicate to the subject, the 'is', is the copula.
zh: 判断是一个对象在概念的各不同环节中的表述。
它包含这一对象：a) 在个别性的规定中，作为主体；b) 它的普遍性的规定或它的谓词——不过，主体也可以像个别性之于特殊性、特殊性之于普遍性那样与谓词相关；c) 谓词对主体的那种简单而无内容的关系，那个「是」，就是连系词。

en: The proposition is to be distinguished from the judgment, in which something quite individual, something that has happened, is asserted of a subject, or, as in the universal propositions, something with which it is connected according to necessity, into which it becomes and to which it essentially relates itself as something opposed.
Because in the concept the moments are contained as in a unity, so in the judgment, as the presentation of the concept, there is indeed determination, but not as becoming or opposition.
The lower determination, the subject, raises itself to the universality different from it, the predicate, or is immediately the same.
zh: 应当把命题与判断区分开来：命题中，就一个主体断言某种完全个别的、已发生的事情；或者，如同在普遍命题中那样，断言某种与它按必然性联系着、它变成、并且它本质上作为对立物与之相关的东西。
因为在概念中，各环节是作为被包含在一个统一中而存在的，所以在判断——作为对概念的表述——中固然也有规定，但不是作为生成或对立。
较低的规定，即主体，把自己提升到与它不同的普遍性，即谓词，或者直接就是同一个东西。

en: In logic the judgment is considered according to its pure form, without regard to any determinate, empirical content.

The judgments are distinguished through the bearing which the subject and the predicate have toward one another in the respect of how far their relation is through and in the concept, or is a relation of objectivity upon the concept.
On the kind of this relation depends the higher or absolute truth of the judgment.
Truth is the agreement of the concept with its objectivity.
In the judgment begins this presentation of the concept and of its objectivity, and thereby the domain of truth.
zh: 在逻辑学中，判断是就其纯粹形式被考察的，不顾及任何确定的、经验的内容。
判断凭借主体和谓词在这一方面彼此具有的相互对待而相互区别，这一方面就是：它们的关系在多大程度上是通过概念并在概念之中的，或者是对象性对概念的一种关系。
判断的较高真理或绝对真理，取决于这种关系的种类。
真理是概念与它的对象性的符合。
在判断中，概念及其对象性的这种表述开始了，从而真理的范围也开始了。

en: Insofar as the judgment is the presentation of an object in the different moments of the concept, it is conversely the presentation of the concept in its determinate being — not so much because of the determinate content which the concept-moments have, as because they step out of their unity in the judgment.
Just as the whole judgment presents the concept in its determinate being, so this difference also again becomes the form of the judgment itself.
The subject is the object, and the predicate is its universality, which is to express it as concept.

The movement of the judgment through its different kinds raises this universality to the higher stage, in which it becomes as corresponding to the concept as it can at all be, insofar as it is at all a predicate.
zh: 由于判断是一个对象在概念的各不同环节中的表述，所以反过来，它就是概念在其定在中的表述——与其说是因为概念环节所具有的确定内容，不如说是因为它们在判断中走出它们的统一。
正如整个判断把概念表述在其定在中，这个区别也再次成为判断本身的形式。
主体是对象，而谓词是这个对象的普遍性；谓词应当把它作为概念表达出来。
判断贯穿其各种类的运动把这种普遍性提升到更高的阶段，在这一阶段，只要它毕竟是谓词，它就尽可能地与概念相应。

197.en: A. Quality of the judgments, or judgments of inherence
197.zh: A. 判断的质或固有的判断

en: In the judgment the predicate is immediately a property that accrues to the subject in such a way that, although it indeed relates itself to it as universal in general, it is at the same time only a determinate being of the same, just as it has several determinacies of them.
Universality, the predicate, has here only the significance of an immediate (or sensuous) universality and of the mere commonality with others.
zh: 在判断中，谓词直接地是一种属性，它以这样的方式归于主体：它虽然作为一般的普遍者确实与主体相关，但同时只是主体的一个特定的定在，正如主体具有这属性的若干规定性一样。
普遍性，即谓词，在这里只有一种直接的（或感性的）普遍性的意义，以及与其他东西的单纯共同性的意义。

en: In the qualitative judgment the predicate is both something universal — which side constitutes the form of the judgment — and a determinate quality of the subject, which appears as content.

According to that side the judgment reads, in accordance with its pure form: the individual is a universal; according to this side, the side of content: the individual is determined thus; — affirmative judgment in general.
zh: 在质的判断中，谓词既是某种普遍的东西——这一面构成判断的形式——又是主体的一个特定的质，后者作为内容出现。
按照那一面，判断就其纯粹形式而言是：个别者是一个普遍者；按照这一面，即内容的一面：个别者是如此被规定的；——一般的肯定判断。

en: (This is good; this is bad; this rose is red; this rose is white, etc.)
zh: （这是好的；这是坏的；这朵玫瑰是红的；这朵玫瑰是白的，等等。）

en: Because 1. the individual is just as much not universal, and 2. the subject has not only this determinacy, the qualitative judgment must therefore in both respects also be expressed negatively; negative judgment.
zh: 因为 1. 个别者同样也不是普遍的，并且 2. 主体不只是具有这一规定性，所以质的判断在两个方面也都必须被否定地表述出来；否定判断。

en: (This is not bad; this is not good; this rose is not red, but white, yellow, etc.; this rose is not white, but red, etc.)
zh: （这不是坏的；这不是好的；这朵玫瑰不是红的，而是白的、黄的，等等；这朵玫瑰不是白的，而是红的，等等。）

en: According to form this judgment therefore reads: the individual is not a universal, but a particular; according to content: the individual is not determined thus, but in the first instance otherwise.
In both respects this negative judgment is at the same time also positive.

In the first respect the negation is only the restriction of universality to particularity; in the other respect only some determinacy or other is negated, and through this negation universality, or the higher sphere of the same, comes forth.
zh: 因此，这个判断按照形式来说就是：个别者不是普遍者，而是特殊者；按照内容来说：个别者不是如此被规定的，而首先是以别的方式被规定。
在两个方面，这个否定判断同时也就是肯定的。
在第一个方面，否定只是把普遍性限制为特殊性；在另一个方面，只是某种规定性被否定，而通过这种否定，普遍性——或它的更高的领域——显现出来。

en: Finally, 1. according to form the individual is also not a particular — for particularity is wider than individuality —, but the individual is only the individual; identical judgment.
zh: 最后，1. 按照形式，个别者也并不是特殊者——因为特殊性比个别性更广——，而个别者只是个别者；同一判断。

en: Conversely, 2. according to content the subject is not only this determinacy, but also not merely some other one.
Such a content is too restricted for the subject.
Through this negation of the determinacy, the whole sphere of the predicate and the positive relation that still obtained in the preceding negative judgment is sublated; infinite judgment.
zh: 反过来，2. 按照内容，主体不只是这一规定性，但也不仅仅是什么别的规定性。
这样一种内容对于主体来说是太受限制了。
通过这种对规定性的否定，谓词的整个领域以及在先前的否定判断中仍然存在的肯定的关系就被扬弃了；无限判断。

en: That identical as well as the infinite judgment are no longer judgments.

This has more precisely the significance that the relation of subject and predicate that takes place in the qualitative judgment has sublated itself, namely that of the subject only some immediate determinacy of its determinate being is asserted, a determinacy to which only a superficial universality accrues.
In the infinite judgment a universality is demanded that is not merely a single determinacy.
That identical judgment contains that the subject is determined in and for itself and has returned into itself in its determination.
zh: 那个同一判断和无限判断都不再是判断了。
这更确切地具有这样的意义：在质的判断中所发生的主体与谓词的关系已经扬弃了自身，也就是说，关于主体只有它的定在的某种直接规定性被说出，而这种规定性只有一种表面的普遍性归于它。
在无限判断中，被要求的是这样一种普遍性：它不是仅仅一种个别的规定性。
那个同一判断包含着：主体是自在自为地被规定的，并在它的规定中已经回到自身之中。

en: In the identical and infinite judgment, the relation of subject and predicate is sublated.

This is to be taken, to begin with, as that side of the judgment according to which subject and predicate, with abstraction from their difference, can be considered through the copula as standing in a relation of equality.
In this respect the affirmative judgment can be reversed, insofar as the predicate is taken only in the sense of the range identical with the subject.
zh: 在同一判断和无限判断中，主体与谓词的关系被扬弃了。
这首先须被当作判断的那一面来取，即按照这一面，主体和谓词撇开它们的差别，通过连系词，可以被看作处在一种等同的关系之中。
在这一方面，肯定判断可以被颠倒过来，只要谓词仅仅在与主体同一的范围这一意义上被取用。

en: The negative judgment contains the separation of a determinacy and a subject in such a way, however, that the subject is positively related to the universal, unexpressed sphere of the determinacy.

In that the negated predicate is made into the subject, that universal sphere falls away of itself, and there is present only the inequality of two determinations, regarding which it is then indifferent which one is made into the subject or which one into the predicate.
The negative judgment can therefore be reversed, just as the identical one can be anyway.
zh: 否定判断包含一种规定性与一个主体的分离，但方式是：主体仍肯定地与那一般的、未被表达出来的规定性领域相关。
由于被否定的谓词被当作主体，那个一般领域便自行脱落，剩下的只是两种规定之间的不等同，至于哪一个被当作主体、哪一个被当作谓词，则无关紧要。
因此否定判断可以被颠倒过来，正如同一判断本来也可以被颠倒过来一样。

217.en: B. Quantity of Judgments, or Judgments of Reflection
217.zh: B. 判断的量，或反思判断

en: In the reversal of judgments, abstraction is made from the difference of subject and predicate.
This difference, however, after it has now been sublated as qualitative, is to be taken quantitatively.
zh: 在判断的颠倒中，主体与谓词的差别被撇开。
但这个差别，在它如今作为质的差别被扬弃之后，须按量的方式来取。

en: In that the individual determinacies that the predicate contained sublate themselves, the same has to contain, in a summarizing manner, the manifold determinations of the subject.
Thereby universality ceases to be a mere commonality with others.
It is the subject's own universality, which thus at the same time contains this: that the subject has returned into itself in its predicate.
zh: 由于谓词所曾包含的各个别规定性扬弃自身，这个谓词便须总括地包含主体的多样规定。
由此，普遍性不再是一种与他者的单纯共同性。
它是主体自身的普遍性，因而同时包含着这一点：主体在其谓词中已回到自身之中。

en: Such a judgment is therefore a judgment of reflection, in that reflecting is in general the progression to several determinations of an object and the summarizing of the same in a unity that comes about through this.
zh: 这样的判断因此是一个反思判断，因为反思一般地就是：进展到一个对象的若干规定，并把由此产生的这些规定综合为一个统一。

en: Insofar as its equality with the predicate presents itself in the subject, the latter is a universal which, through restriction, is subject, at first with respect to individuality.
The qualitative judgment is thus 1. a singular one, which for the determination of the subject has perfect individuality, and is a this-universal.
zh: 就主体身上呈现出它与谓词的等同而言，这个主体是一个普遍者，它通过限制，首先就个别性而言是主体。
质的判断因此 1. 是一个单称判断，它以完全的个别性作为对主体的规定，是一个「这一个」的普遍者。

en: A this, however, is infinitely manifoldly determined, i.e. indeterminately determinable.
The reflection-predicate, since it is a summarizing, expresses not only the universal determination of a this, but also of other thises; or the singular judgment passes over into the particular.
zh: 但一个「这一个」却是无限多样地被规定的，亦即尚未规定地可被规定。
反思谓词，由于它是一个综合，不仅表达出对一个「这一个」的一般规定，也表达出对其他「这一个」的一般规定；或者说，单称判断过渡为特称判断。

en: The particular judgment, in which the subject is determined as some, is a merely determinate judgment that can be immediately asserted just as much positively as negatively.
zh: 特称判断，其中主体被规定为某一些，是一个只是被规定的判断，它可以直接地同样既作肯定的陈述又作否定的陈述。

en: The subject receives its complete determination, in respect of the extent of the form, through the allness in the universal judgment.
In that allness takes the place of particularity and at the same time has the extent of the latter, the extent of the content of the subject must accordingly be restricted.
zh: 主体按照形式之范围，通过全称判断中的全体性而获得其完整的规定。
由于全体性取代了特称性的位置，同时又具有特称性的范围，主体内容之范围就必须相应地受到限制。

en: By this the subject becomes in part a particular over against its predicate, and in part a relation of necessity between subject and predicate thereby sets in.
zh: 主体由此一方面成为与它的谓词相对的特殊者，另一方面，主体与谓词的一种必然性的关系也就此发生。

234.en: C. Relation of judgments or judgments of necessity
234.zh: C. 判断的关系或必然的判断

en: Through the sublation of the qualitative and quantitative determination, the unity of the content of subject and predicate is posited, which are distinguished only through the form, so that the same object is posited the one time only in the determination of the subject, the other time in the determination of the predicate.
zh: 通过扬弃质的规定和量的规定，主体与谓词的内容之统一被建立起来，二者只是通过形式而被区别，以致同一个对象一次只是在主体的规定中被建立，另一次则是在谓词的规定中被建立。

en: In that the subject is a particular over against its predicate, conversely, as against the qualitative judgment, the subject is now a determinacy of the predicate and is immediately subsumed under it.

The universality of the predicate thus expresses not merely a combining of the determinacies of the subject, as the reflection-predicate does, but the universal inner nature of the subject; categorical judgment.
zh: 由于主体是与它的谓词相对的特殊者，所以反过来，与质的判断相对，主体如今是谓词的一个规定性，并被直接归摄在谓词之下。
谓词的普遍性因此表达出来的，不仅仅是对主体诸规定性的一种综合，就像反思谓词那样，而是主体的普遍的、内在的本性；定言判断。

en: (The body is heavy.
Gold is metal.
The spirit is rational.)
zh: (物体是重的。
金是金属。
精神是有理性的。)

en: Insofar as subject and predicate are also distinguished, their unity must also be expressed as unity of opposed terms, i. e. as necessary relation; hypothetical judgment.
zh: 就主体与谓词也被区别而言，它们的统一也必须作为对立者的统一，即作为必然的关系而被表达出来；假言判断。

en: The identity of content that takes place in the categorical judgment, and the relation of opposed or other terms in the hypothetical judgment, are united in the disjunctive judgment, in which the subject is a universal sphere or is considered in respect of such a one, which equally constitutes the predicate, and whose particularization or various determinations express this.
Of these, both the one and the other accrue to the universal.
But according to their particularization and in respect of the subject, they mutually exclude one another.
zh: 在定言判断中发生的内容的同一性，与在假言判断中对立者或他物的关系，在选言判断中被结合在一起，在选言判断中主体是一个普遍领域，或者是就这样一个领域而被考察的，这个领域同样构成谓词，而这个领域的特殊化或种种不同的规定则表达出这个谓词。
在这些规定中，无论是这一个还是那一个，都属于普遍者。
但按照它们的特殊化，并且就主体而言，它们相互排斥。

244.en: D. Modality of judgments, or judgments of the relation of the concept to determinate being
244.zh: D. 判断的模态，或概念对定在的关系的判断

en: In the disjunctive judgment, a determinate being is posited in the complete moments of the concept.
The modality of judgments now consists in this, that a determinate being is related to its concept as such, and the predicate expresses the adequacy or inadequacy of both.
zh: 在选言判断中，一个定在被建立于概念的完整环节之中。
判断的模态如今在于：一个定在者与它的概念本身相关联，而谓词则表达出这两者的相宜或不相宜。

en: The first judgment of modality is the assertoric one, which contains a mere assurance insofar as the constitution of the subject, which is to be compared with the concept, and the concept itself are not yet expressed, so that that judgment as yet has only a subjective substantiation.
zh: 模态的第一个判断是断言判断，它之所以只包含一种单纯的保证，是因为应当与概念相比对的主体的性质以及概念本身还没有被表达出来，因此那个判断迄今只具有一种主观的证成。

en: (This action is bad; this speech is true.)
zh: (这一行为是坏的；这一说法是真的。)

en: Against the assertion of the assertive judgment, the opposite assertion can therefore equally be maintained, and the predicate expresses only one of those opposite determinacies, both of which the subject, regarded as universal sphere, can contain in itself.
This judgment therefore passes over into the problematic [judgment], which only expresses the possibility that determinate being is adequate to the concept, or is not.
zh: 因此，对断言的判断的断言，也同样可以主张相反的断言；而谓词只表达出那些相反的规定性之一，主体作为一般的领域来看，则能够把两者都包含在自身之内。
因此这个判断便过渡为有问题的判断，后者仅仅说出这样一种可能性：定在与概念相宜或不相宜。

en: The universality of the subject is therefore posited with a restriction, which expresses the constitution in which the adequacy or inadequacy of determinate being with the concept lies.
The predicate expresses nothing other than this equality or inequality of the constitution and the concept of the thing.
This judgment is apodictic.
zh: 因此，主体的普遍性是带着一种限制被设定的，这种限制表达出那样一种性质：定在与概念的相宜或不相宜就落在其中。
谓词所表达的无非就是这种性质与事情的概念之间的等同或不等同。
这个判断是断言式的。

en: The syllogism is the complete presentation of the concept.
It contains in general the judgment along with its ground.
In it two determinations are joined together through a third, which is their unity.
There is a concept present in its unity, the middle of the syllogism, and in its diremption, the extremes of the syllogism.
zh: 推论是概念的完整表述。
它一般地包含着判断连同其根据。
其中两个规定由第三个——即它们的统一——结合在一起。
有一个概念现存着，处在其统一——推论的中项——中，并处在其分裂——推论的极端——中。

en: The relation of the two extremes of the syllogism to the middle is an immediate one; their relation to one another, however, is mediated through the middle.
Those two immediate relations are the judgments which are called premises; the relation which is mediated is called the syllogistic conclusion.
zh: 推论的两个极端对中项的关系是直接的；但它们彼此之间的关系则是通过中项而被中介的。
那两个直接的关系就是判断，它们叫做前提；那个被中介了的关系则叫做推论句。

en: To begin with, the syllogism expresses its moments through the mere form, so that the middle is a proper determinacy over against the extremes, and the ground or the unity of the moments is still a subjective one.
What is in itself original is here something inferred, and has the meaning of a consequence.
zh: 首先，推论通过单纯的形式来表述它的各个环节，以至于中项对极端而言是一个特有的规定性，而诸环节的根据或统一还是一个主观的。
那在自身中原始的东西在这里是一个被推论出来的东西，并且具有一种后果的意义。

261.en: A. Syllogisms of quality, or of inherence
261.zh: A. 质的推论或固有的推论

en: The form of this syllogism, E - B - A, that the individual is joined together with the universal through the particular, is the universal rule of the syllogism in general. — In the first immediate syllogism, the particular, or the middle, is a quality or determinacy of the individual, and likewise the universal is a determinacy of the particular.

Hence, from the individual, through another of its determinacies — of which it has several — one can equally pass over from the latter to another universal, as well as from the particular to another universal, since the particular likewise contains various determinations in itself.
This syllogism therefore appears, according to its form, indeed correct, but according to its content, as arbitrary and contingent.
(Green is a pleasant color.
This leaf is green.
Therefore it is pleasant. — The sensible is neither good nor evil.
Now man is sensible.
Therefore he is neither good nor evil. — Courage is a virtue.
Alexander possessed courage.
Therefore he was virtuous. — Drunkenness is a vice.
Alexander was devoted to drink.
Therefore he was vicious, and so forth.)
zh: 这个推论的形式，E - B - A，即个别者与普遍者通过特殊者被结合在一起，就是推论一般的普遍规则。——在第一个直接的推论中，特殊者或中项是个别者的一种质或规定性，同样，普遍者也是特殊者的一种规定性。
因此，从个别者出发，经由它的另一个规定性——它有若干个规定性——也同样可以从后者出发过渡到另一个普遍者，正如可以从特殊者过渡到另一个普遍者，因为特殊者同样在自身中包含着各种规定。
因此这个推论按其形式来看虽然正确，但按其内容来看却是任意的和偶然的。
（绿是一种令人愉快的颜色。
这片叶子是绿的。
所以它是令人愉快的。——感性的东西既不是好的也不是恶的。
人是感性的。
所以他既不是好的也不是恶的。——勇敢是一种美德。
亚历山大具有勇敢。
所以他是有美德的。——酗酒是一种恶习。
亚历山大耽于饮酒。
所以他是有恶习的，云云。）

en: As to form, the two premises are immediate relations.

The form of the syllogism, however, contains the demand that they likewise be mediated or, in the usual expression, that the premises be proved. — But the proof through this form of the syllogism would only be a repetition of the very same form, in which the same demand would also repeat itself to infinity.
zh: 就形式而言，两个前提是直接的关系。
但推论的形式包含着这样一种要求，即它们同样是被中介的，或者用通常的说法，即前提应当得到证明。——但通过推论形式的这种证明只会是同一个形式的重复，在其中同一个要求也会无限地重复自身。

en: The mediation, namely of particularity and universality, must therefore come about through the moment of individuality.
This gives the second form of the syllogism: A - E - B. This syllogism is correct, for one thing, only insofar as A - E is a valid judgment.
That this is the case requires that A be particular.
In this way, it is not properly the individual that is the middle.
The syllogism is brought back to the form of the first, but the conclusion is particular.

(Some logicians say that it is not necessary to reduce the other figure to the first, since one can conclude in it, but in fact only by virtue of this form.) — For another thing, however, this syllogism has in general the significance that immediate determinations or qualities are joined together through individuality and, to that extent, contingently.
zh: 因此，中介——即特殊性与普遍性的中介——必须通过个别性这一环节来发生。
这就给出推论的第二种形式：A - E - B。这个推论首先只在这一点上是正确的，即 A - E 是一个有效的判断。
要使之成为事实，A 必须是特称的。
以这种方式，真正说来并不是个别者充当中项。
推论被带回到第一种形式那里，但推论句是特称的。
（有些逻辑学家说，把另一格带回到第一格那里并不是必要的，因为在其中就能够进行推论，但事实上只是凭借这种形式。）——但另一方面，这个推论总地说来具有这样的意义：直接的规定或质通过个别性、并在这一意义上偶然地被结合在一起。

en: The individual joined together with the particular through the universal gives the third form of the syllogism: B - A - E. The universal is here the mediating determination and, in the two premises, the predicate.

But just as it does not follow, from the fact that two determinations inhere in the same individual, that they are the same, so too it does not follow, from the fact that two determinations are subsumed under the same universal, that they can be joined as subject and predicate.
Only insofar as the major premise is negative and can therefore be reversed, can this syllogism be reduced to the first and thereby have the correct form.
zh: 个别者与特殊者通过普遍者被结合在一起，这就给出推论的第三种形式：B - A - E。普遍者在这里是中介着的规定，并且在两个前提中是谓词。
但是，正如从两个规定固有于同一个个别者这一点，推不出它们是同一个东西，同样，从两个规定被归摄于同一个普遍者之下这一点，也推不出它们能够作为主体和谓词被联结起来。
只要大前提是否定的、因而能够被颠倒过来，这个推论就能够被带回到第一个那里，并因此而具有正确的形式。

en: (No finite being is holy.
God is not a finite being.
Therefore God is holy.)
zh: （没有有限的存在者是神圣的。
上帝不是有限的存在者。
所以上帝是神圣的。）

en: The objective significance of this syllogism is that the union of particularity with individuality has its ground only in the identical nature of both.
zh: 这个推论的客观意义是：特殊性与个别性的结合，其根据只在两者的同一本性中。

en: In the series of these syllogisms, each of the three determinations has, first, constituted the middle.
The reduction of the second and third forms of the syllogism is the sublation of the qualitative.

Secondly, to be sure, every immediate relation of the first syllogism has been mediated by the following ones, but each of these presupposes the preceding one, i.e., the mediated unity [posits] the immediate equality as a presupposition.
zh: 在这一系列推论中，首先，三个规定中的每一个都曾充当中项。
把第二种和第三种推论形式带回去，就是对质的东西的扬弃。
其次，诚然，第一个推论的每一个直接关系都通过后面的推论被中介了，但这些推论中的每一个都把前一个设定为前提，即被中介的统一[把]直接的等同设定为前提。

275.en: B. Syllogisms of quantity, or of reflection
275.zh: B. 量的推论或反思推论

en: The immediately qualityless syllogism is the mathematical one.
The middle in it is only such a thing as is equal to two others.
Expressed as a proposition, it runs: if two magnitudes are equal to a third, then they are equal to one another.
zh: 那个直接地无质的推论就是数学的推论。
其中的中项只是这样一个东西：它与另外两个等同。
作为命题表达出来，它就是：如果两个量与第三个量等同，那么它们彼此等同。

en: Secondly, in the quantitative syllogism the middle term is constituted by individuality not as one individual, but as all individuals.
Insofar as at the same time some quality belongs to all, this quality is expressed as quality of that universal sphere or genus itself to which the individuals belong; syllogism of induction.
zh: 其次，在量的推论中，个别性不是作为一个别者，而是作为所有个别者构成中项。
只要同时有一种质属于全体，这种质就被表述为那些个别者所属的那个一般领域或属本身的质；归纳的推论。

en: The syllogism in which the universal is the middle term infers through analogy that, in the case of two subjects which are the same according to their universal determination, a particular determination which belongs to the one also belongs to the other.
zh: 在其中普遍者构成中项的那个推论，通过类比推出：两个按其普遍规定彼此相同的主体，属于这一个的那种特殊规定，也属于另一个。

en: (a. Several individuals have a universal nature.
zh: (a. 好些个别者有一种普遍本性。

en: b. One of the individuals has a quality.
zh: b. 其中一个别者有一种质。

en: c. Hence also the other individuals have this quality.)
zh: c. 所以其余个别者也有这种质。)

en: (In induction what matters is what is to become subject or predicate in the conclusion, e. g. what moves freely, - is an animal; or: an animal is - what moves freely. - The lion - is a mammal; or: what is a mammal - is a lion.

In analogy, by contrast, the mediation lies in the fact that another individual has the same universal nature, whereas in induction the particular determinacy of the universal nature is grounded in the individual.
Analogy infers from the universal nature to the particular determinacy of the individual, e. g.: the earth has motion; the moon is an earth; hence the moon has motion.)
zh: (在归纳那里，要紧的是在推论句中什么应当成为主体或谓词，例如：能自由运动的东西，——是动物；或：动物是——能自由运动的东西。——狮子——是哺乳动物；或：凡哺乳动物的东西——就是狮子。
在类比那里则相反，中介在于：另一个个别者具有同一个普遍本性，反之在归纳那里，普遍本性的特殊规定性则奠基在个别者之中。
类比从普遍本性推论到个别者的特殊规定性，例如：地球有运动；月亮是一个地球；所以月亮也有运动。)
